messages:
anya: Heads-up from bizdev — Prospero asks to start an Early Access on 2026-08-10. They want predictable p99 and a lightweight pinning UX.
derek: earliest we can deliver manual pin + p99 hooks is ~3 weeks unless we drop some noncritical console work.
nina: product tradeoff: drop the advanced quota UI and deferred cost-by-route. we keep basic usage CSVs for customers.
sam: eng: manual pin + audit log + p99 alerting = 2w. canary automation + dashboard is another 2w. ops: we can support pilot if traffic is capped.
anya: propose: ship manual API pin + audit logs for EA; cut advanced quota UI to v1; enforce 2k req/day cap and canary ramp 5/20/60. rollback SLA: 4hr remediation.
derek: agree but need support visibility. add an audit webhook so support sees pin changes and rollbacks.
nina: will add customer-facing note clarifying quality delta on fallback and list deferred features.
sam: ops-bot: scheduled pipeline "ea/prospero/manual-pin" queued for 2026-08-06 02:00 UTC. status: queued.
anya: action items: sam - implement manual pin + audit webhook (due 8/4); derek - draft customer EA note + quality caveat (due 8/3); nina - update roadmap to reflect deferred features to v1 (due 8/3).
derek: ack. i'll also prepare a canned cost snapshot for Prospero so they aren't blind to token spend.
anya: if any blocker, flag here. otherwise i'll confirm with BD and legal. :thumbsup:
